content='''def transform(grid):
    # Highlight vertical bars of the foreground color that cross the long horizontal bar,
    # continuing below it, using the non-background accent.
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    bg=grid[0][0]
    from collections import Counter
    colors=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    fg=next(c for c,n in colors.items() if c!=bg)
    # Identify longest horizontal run of foreground.
    runs=[]
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        cs=[i for i,x in enumerate(row) if x==fg]
        if cs: runs.append((len(cs),r,cs))
    _,hr,cs=max(runs)
    accent=next((c for c in range(10) if c not in (bg,fg)),0)
    for c in cs:
        if grid[hr][c]==fg and sum(grid[r][c]==fg for r in range(len(grid)))>=3:
            for r in range(hr,len(grid)):
                if grid[r][c]==fg: g[r][c]=accent
    return g
'''
